_still_suspended.thin_extent: OWNED BY THE MEASUREMENT DISPATCH: the fresh cost curve (fraction of visible figure withheld per candidate value, and separately WHAT FRACTION OF THE BLADE each candidate withholds - the blade is this subject's membrane-analog and its whole point). THE BOX-SECTION CAVEAT rides the curve: the blade is hollow (E14 Ruling 3) - total outer thickness ~0.0208 at mid-blade around a cavity - and the two-sided extent probe reads OUTER-TO-OUTER (~0.021), not wall thickness (~0.002), so the curve is honest about apparent thinness and silent about the walls; stated so nobody discovers it mid-experiment. NO inherited value transfers (character 0.03 figure-derived / ship 0.01 filament / beast 0.005 wing-artifact-criterion). The VALUE is decided at this subject's own ruling with the curve and artifact crops in the room - the beast's deferral pattern, which held. Until then texpass_iter's key is deliberately absent: undecided runs the guard DISABLED (tool default 0.0), the beast's own mid-arc state.

The restylize keys are deliberately absent until then - the sweep counting them UNDECIDED is the expected state, exactly as the beast's thin-extent was.
_still_suspended.palette_bands: Derive from the fixture's named materials AFTER the styled target pair exists, cross-checked against the pair - never against the twins they will gate (non-circularity, kept). PRE-REGISTERED HAZARD, named at authoring: L1 steel and L2 iron are BOTH below any chroma floor by construction - they cannot carry hue bands at all, and their separation is by VALUE (the achromatic channel, 17d's permanent member, is the instrument that sees them; the hue gate is blind to this subject's two largest elements BY DESIGN). The band candidates are gold (warm) and the wine family (oxblood + garnet, likely one merged band - the D4/D5/D10 merge precedent). Suspend rather than invent; the dark-rows shadow caveat (15j) will bite on blackened iron exactly as it bit on charcoal.
